faq.q: Is there an airport in GTA 6?
faq.a: Yes. Vice City International Airport appears in the background of shots in the first official trailer, identifiable by its air-traffic-control tower and radar installation.

faq.q: What is Vice City International Airport based on?
faq.a: Its real-world basis is Miami International Airport, according to the record.

faq.q: What area does the airport serve in GTA 6?
faq.a: Press outlets covering the trailer frame by frame describe it as the primary airport serving the Vice-Dale County area of Leonida.

faq.q: Has Rockstar officially named the airport?
faq.a: No. Rockstar has not published a dedicated Newswire post or screenshot naming the airport directly, so its exact name and role rely on trailer visuals interpreted by press and community sources.

notKnown: Whether players can enter or use the airport during gameplay.
howWeKnow: Vice City International Airport was first identified in Trailer 1, released 5 December 2023, and documented by GTA6Locations.com through frame-by-frame analysis of the control tower and radar dish. This is press and community-tier reporting, since Rockstar has not confirmed the airport by name.
